description: Verify MCP console client configuration (preview). Each valid config_json must parse to expected (delegation_cert_ids lists the decoded certificates' cert_id, in order); each invalid one must be refused. A top-level client_config object is unwrapped; unknown fields are ignored. delegations are root side first: each certificate's subject (ID and public key) is the next one's issuer, and the last is issued to the agent key.
